brand.name: Haqq Report
brand.tagline: Facts first. Sources named. Corrections public.

mode_notes: review = every draft goes to Telegram for approval (first 4 weeks). auto = Green and Amber post automatically, Red always needs approval.

owner_feed.note: Private Telegram messages to the owner (TELEGRAM_OWNER_ID). No public channel needed.
owner_feed.log_file_note: Send each run's log file to Telegram: always | on_error | never

meta.graph_version_note: Use the Graph API version shown in the Meta dashboard if newer.

ai.model_note: Tried in order; a model that returns 400/403/404 is skipped. Run the ai-check workflow to see which models your keys can use, then put those first. gemini-2.0-flash was shut down on 2026-06-01.

election_silence.note: Dates (YYYY-MM-DD) on which political content for a given country must not be published. Telegram reminder 14 days before.

site.base_url_note: Set once the website is deployed (Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages).
